events.name: July 2019 Pune Floods (Mutha River Overflow)
events.source: PMC Disaster Management Cell & Pune Mirror Archives
events.description: Massive urban flooding caused by 45,000 cusecs discharge from Khadakwasla Dam into the Mutha river, heavily impacting inner-city Pune areas.

closed_roads.name: Baba Bhide Bridge (Deccan Gymkhana)
closed_roads.reason: Fully submerged under Mutha River

closed_roads.name: Sambhaji Bridge (Lakdi Pul) Approach
closed_roads.reason: Traffic halted due to water reaching road level

closed_roads.name: Deccan Hanging Bridge (Z Bridge) Area
closed_roads.reason: Riverside road leading to Z-bridge flooded and inaccessible

closed_roads.name: Mhatre Bridge Riverside Road
closed_roads.reason: Waterlogged approach roads

closed_roads.name: Jayantrao Tilak Bridge
closed_roads.reason: Water flowing perilously close to bridge deck

closed_roads.name: Sinhagad Road (Anand Nagar to Vadgaon)
closed_roads.reason: Red Line Inundation Buffer Reached

events.name: Sept 2022 Ambil Odha Flash Floods
events.description: Severe flash flooding from intense cloudburst-like rain caused the Ambil Odha stream to breach its retaining walls in the heart of the city.

closed_roads.name: Ambil Odha Bank Road
closed_roads.reason: Stream overflowed directly onto street, cars washed away

closed_roads.name: Pune-Satara Road (Katraj to Swargate)
closed_roads.reason: 3 feet of standing water near Swargate junction

closed_roads.name: Sinhagad Road Junction
closed_roads.reason: Massive traffic jam and waterlogging

events.name: October 2020 Inner-City Waterlogging
events.description: Late monsoon heavy downpour causing severe waterlogging and gridlock across central Pune streets and underpasses.

closed_roads.name: Karve Road
closed_roads.reason: Waist-deep waterlogging near Garware College

closed_roads.name: Sancheti Hospital Underpass (Shivajinagar)
closed_roads.reason: Fully submerged, vehicles trapped

closed_roads.name: Paud Road
closed_roads.reason: Vehicles stranded in flood water

events.name: July 2014 Malin Landslide Disaster
events.description: Catastrophic mudslide in Ambegaon taluka of Pune district following exceptional rainfall.

closed_roads.name: Dimbhe Dam Approach Road
closed_roads.reason: Blocked for NDRF rescue operations

closed_roads.name: Malin-Adivare Connecting Road
closed_roads.reason: Buried under mudslide debris

events.name: PMC Chronic Urban Flooding Hotspots Review
events.source: PMC Smart City Audits & Stormwater Drain Reports
events.description: A comprehensive map of roads and underpasses in Pune that have previously flooded multiple times due to poor drainage and topography, serving as critical watch-points for first responders.

closed_roads.name: Swargate Underpass
closed_roads.reason: Previously flooded: Chronic water accumulation point during >50mm rain

closed_roads.name: Sancheti Hospital Grade Separator
closed_roads.reason: Previously flooded: Submerges rapidly blocking Shivajinagar

closed_roads.name: Ambedkar Chowk (Bopodi)
closed_roads.reason: Previously flooded: Highway traffic completely halted in 2022

closed_roads.name: Wagholi Highway Stretch
closed_roads.reason: Previously flooded: Knee-deep water due to nullah encroachment

closed_roads.name: Airport Road (Symbiosis Square)
closed_roads.reason: Previously flooded: Recurrent 2ft waterlogging blocking airport transit

closed_roads.name: Chandni Chowk Old Bypass
closed_roads.reason: Previously flooded: Steep gradient runoff causes severe hazard

events.name: January 2021 Serum Institute Fire
events.description: A massive industrial fire at the Serum Institute of India (Manjari facility) requiring city-wide emergency response and traffic cordoning.

affected_settlements.name: Manjari Green / SII Campus
affected_settlements.notes: Thick smoke and toxic fumes hazard

closed_roads.name: Pune-Solapur Highway (Hadapsar Bypass)
closed_roads.reason: Cordoned off for 15+ fire tenders to access facility

closed_roads.name: Manjari Road
closed_roads.reason: Zero visibility due to smoke

closed_roads.name: Magarpatta South Gate Approach
closed_roads.reason: Severe traffic bottleneck from diverted vehicles
